title: Female College Graduate, 1940s B&W Snapshot, Campus Building
description: A full-length black and white snapshot from the late 1940s depicting a smiling young female graduate standing on a concrete walkway on a college campus. She wears a traditional academic gown, mortarboard cap with tassel, and mid-century ankle-strap heel shoes. Behind her stands an impressive building featuring Spanish Colonial Revival architectural elements with tall arched loggias and multi-pane windows. The photo features scalloped deckle edges characteristic of mid-20th-century photographic prints.
